name: 33196 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33196 (Miami) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33196 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33196 (Miami) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.
